speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To determine if this is a complication like acute pyelonephritis or sepsis, how would you describe the nature of your flank pain and have you noticed any changes in your urine?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis (post-sinusitis complication, likely due to hematogenous spread or misdirected antibiotic coverage). The clinical picture of fever, fatigue, and flank pain persisting after sinusitis treatment strongly suggests an ascending or hematogenous urinary tract infection involving the kidneys. Immediate evaluation of urinalysis and blood cultures is warranted to confirm the diagnosis and guide antibiotic therapy.
